PMJAY.name: Aadhaar Card
PMJAY.purpose: Identity verification and e-KYC for card generation.
PMJAY.when_required: At the time of e-KYC / card generation via CSC, hospital Ayushman Mitra desk, or the app.
PMJAY.notes: Confirmed as commonly used for e-KYC across NHA-linked processes, but an exhaustive official document checklist page was not directly fetched in this pass.

PMJAY.name: Ration Card / Family ID
PMJAY.purpose: Household identification for matching against the SECC 2011 database.
PMJAY.when_required: As an alternative or supplementary identifier to Aadhaar during eligibility search.

VAYVANDANA.name: Aadhaar Card
VAYVANDANA.purpose: Mandatory age verification (70+) and e-KYC for enrolment and card issuance.
VAYVANDANA.when_required: At the time of enrolment / e-KYC.

CGHS.name: Photograph (applicant and dependents)
CGHS.notes: Standard document list drawn from secondary process guides, not the primary Annual Report source used for eligibility categories; should be reconfirmed at cghs.mohfw.gov.in (SRC008).

CGHS.name: Proof of residence
CGHS.purpose: To confirm residence in a CGHS-covered city, which determines eligibility.

CGHS.name: Proof of dependents
CGHS.purpose: To register eligible dependent family members.

CGHS.name: Pension Payment Order (PPO) or provisional PPO / Last Pay Certificate
CGHS.purpose: Proof of pensioner status for retired employees.
CGHS.when_required: For pensioner applicants only, at time of application.

ESIC.name: Employer registration documents (Form 1, PAN, address proof, registration certificate, employee list)
ESIC.purpose: For the EMPLOYER to register the establishment with ESIC.
ESIC.when_required: At the time of establishment registration (employer-side, within 15 days of the Act becoming applicable).
ESIC.notes: Individual-employee document requirements beyond payroll enrolment were not confirmed against a primary source in this research pass.

CMCHIS.name: Self-declaration by head of family
CMCHIS.purpose: Declares household composition and eligibility basis.

CMCHIS.name: Ration Card / Family Card
CMCHIS.purpose: Proof that the applicant's name is part of an eligible household.

CMCHIS.name: Income Certificate (issued by Village Administrative Officer / Revenue authorities)
CMCHIS.purpose: To verify the household falls within the (currently unverified) income ceiling.
